cleanup.title: Post-processing cleanup
cleanup.livePreview: Live preview as you drag. Press <1>Apply cleanup</1> to commit — afterwards exports & Analysis see the cleaned map.
cleanup.dataSliders: <1>Sliders</1> = view-only filter. Nothing on disk or in memory changes; switch display modes freely — rejected pixels look unindexed (grey) in Phase, IPF <3>and</3> CI views alike.
cleanup.dataApply: <1>Apply cleanup</1> writes the filtered phase assignment into the in-memory result (or the batch checkpoint). .ang / .h5 exports, the Analysis handoff and downstream tools all see the cleaned map.
cleanup.dataOrientations: <1>Orientations are never fabricated.</1> Even when <3>Fill unindexed</3> or <5>Modal smoothing</5> reassigns a pixel's phase, its IPF colour stays grey unless the pixel had a real measurement — we only ever relabel, we don't invent rotations.
cleanup.ciThresholdTooltip: Reject pixels whose best-match confidence is below this floor.
cleanup.uncertaintyTooltip: Difference between best and second-best CI. Small = ambiguous phase call. Multi-phase only.
cleanup.minClusterTooltip: Any same-phase cluster with fewer pixels than this gets absorbed into its neighbours.
cleanup.modalSmoothingTooltip: Replace each pixel with the most common phase in its window — kills isolated speckle.
cleanup.fillUnindexed: Fill unindexed pixels from nearest neighbour
cleanup.fillUnindexedTooltip: Fill unindexed (−1) pixels with the phase of the nearest indexed neighbour.
cleanup.applyTooltip: Persist the cleanup to the indexing result. Future exports (.ang/.h5) and the Analysis handoff will see the cleaned phase map.
cleanup.resetFiltersTooltip: Discard live cleanup and render raw assignment
cleanup.explainCi: <1>CI threshold</1> — drops pixels where no phase matched well. Classic noise-floor.
cleanup.explainUncertainty: <1>Uncertainty</1> — drops ambiguous pixels where best and second-best CI are close (multi-phase only).
cleanup.explainMinCluster: <1>Min cluster</1> — absorbs tiny same-phase islands (speckle) into neighbours.
cleanup.explainModal: <1>Modal smoothing</1> — majority-vote window, MTEX-style. 3×3 for mild, 5×5 for aggressive.
cleanup.explainFill: <1>Fill unindexed</1> — heals pinholes left by the CI / uncertainty cutoffs.

phaseLegend.title: Phase Legend
phaseLegend.showEmptyTooltip: Also list phases that were input to indexing but ended up with zero indexed pixels. Useful for auditing which input phases never won.
phaseLegend.loadPrompt: Load an indexing result to see the phase legend.
phaseLegend.suspectTooltip: Suspect: {{area}}% area but only median CI {{ci}}. CI is a within-phase correlation peak, not a true fit — a degenerate cubic phase can score OK on a noisy pattern. Verify with Pattern Match Quality (forward-NCC R) before trusting this phase.
phaseLegend.footnote: <1>Ø</1> = median CI = a <3>within-phase</3> correlation peak. A high CI does <5>not</5> prove the phase is right — chemically-impossible cubic phases can win by symmetry on noisy patterns. For a trustworthy fit check use <7>Pattern Match Quality</7> (forward-NCC R) or the <9>Forward NCC</9> diagnostic layer. To prevent wrong winners, restrict the phase list to chemically-plausible phases before indexing.

pseudosym.title: Pseudo-Symmetry
pseudosym.tip: Fix pseudo-symmetry variant speckle for the WHOLE map: grains are segmented modulo the supergroup, each grain's variant is decided by aggregated render match over its best pixels, coherent twin domains are only flipped on a clear margin. One-level undo via the Pattern-Match dialog.
pseudosym.hint: Removes IPF variant speckle per grain, render-verified. Twins are protected.
pseudosym.done: Unified {{changed}} px across {{grains}} grains ({{ambiguous}} ambiguous, {{rescued}} rescued).

ipfStabilize.label: Stabilize colors per grain
ipfStabilize.tip: Route every pixel of a grain through the same side of the IPF color-key discontinuity. Colors stay per-pixel, so intra-grain gradients are preserved — only the color-key branch is chosen consistently per grain. For low-symmetry phases (e.g. m-3 approximants) the key is discontinuous, so ~1° orientation noise would otherwise flip pixel colors and make smooth data look like color speckle. Display-only; the stored orientations are untouched.

ipfPhaseFilter.label: Phase:
ipfPhaseFilter.tip: Show only the selected phase as an IPF map; all other phases become transparent. Each phase has its own color key (fundamental sector), so mixed IPF maps with identical RGB codes are ambiguous — the community standard is one IPF map per phase. The on-canvas color key follows this selection. Display/export only; the data is untouched.

phaseCheck.title: Phase Verification (render)
phaseCheck.checkTip: Read-only check: per grain, render the STORED phase at its stored orientation and every other phase at a Hough-anchored orientation, and compare against the measured pattern (render-NCC). Internal indexing scores are not comparable across phases — the forward render is. Adds a 'Phase Check' layer: green = stored phase wins, red = another phase renders clearly better, transparent = healthy.
phaseCheck.checkDone: Checked {{grains}} grains: {{suspect}} suspect, {{reassign}} recommended for reassignment.
phaseCheck.reassignTip: Apply the check's recommendations: whole grains flip to the phase that renders clearly better (margin ≥ 0.05); every pixel gets its own Hough orientation from the winning phase. Grains are never split; ambiguous grains are left untouched. One-level undo.
phaseCheck.unifyHint: Reassigned phase(s) {{phases}} are pseudo-symmetric — run 'Unify variants' next.
phaseCheck.undoTip: Restore the phase ids and orientations changed by the last reassignment.
phaseCheck.hint: Finds grains stored as the wrong phase (chemically degenerate phases). Render-verified, whole grains only, undo available.
phaseCheck.checkDoneIslands: Plus {{islands}} wrong pixels inside grains ({{px}} px) — too small for the per-grain check.
phaseCheck.islandsFailed: The inside-grain pixel check could not run: {{err}}
phaseCheck.reassignDoneIslands: Fixed {{islands}} wrong pixels inside grains ({{px}} px).
phaseCheck.checkDoneIslandsFairness: {{undecided}} islands could not be judged (no reliable orientation for the stored phase) and were left alone; {{rescued}} turned out to be a bad orientation, not a wrong phase.
phaseCheck.checkDoneGrainsFairness: {{undecided}} suspect grains could not be judged (no reliable orientation for the stored phase) and were left alone; {{rescued}} turned out to be a bad orientation, not a wrong phase.
